description: one-metre clip-on non-structural glass-fibre/GFRP body modules
retention: keyed hook plus captive over-centre clip and independent anti-lift retainer
seal: replaceable dry EPDM compression gasket; no production adhesive cure
structural_role: non-structural weather skin; steel frame remains the certified load path
moulding_basis: reusable 1,000 mm side and roof moulds with CNC-trimmed solid, window-edge, door-edge, and roof variants
fabrication_route: mould, cure, demould, CNC trim/drill, edge seal, fit inserts/clips/gaskets, master-frame dry fit

fabrication_plan.activity: Release mould, trim fixture, laminate schedule, core map, insert map, and module serial range
fabrication_plan.release_check: traveler revision, material certificates, and mould release are accepted

fabrication_plan.activity: Clean mould, inspect A-surface, apply release system, and apply UV-stable gelcoat or paint-primer layer
fabrication_plan.release_check: mould surface record and release-system lot recorded

fabrication_plan.activity: Cut glass reinforcement and local core, lay up solid clip lands, pot insert bosses, and bag or close mould
fabrication_plan.release_check: ply/core/insert checklist matches the released module variant

fabrication_plan.activity: Infuse or wet-lay laminate, control cure, demould, post-cure where specified, and keep witness coupons with the batch
fabrication_plan.release_check: cure time/temperature record, coupon ID, and demould inspection complete

fabrication_plan.activity: CNC trim door/window/roof variant, drill clip grid from datum, seal all cut edges, and mark serial/revision
fabrication_plan.release_check: trim gauge, hole-position gauge, and edge-seal record accepted

fabrication_plan.activity: Fit captive inserts, clips, anti-lift features, drain details, and EPDM seals; dry-fit to master frame
fabrication_plan.release_check: insert pull-out lot, gasket compression witness, and master-frame fit accepted

assembly_plan.activity: Receive three released frames and verify clip-rail datums
Fit dry EPDM seals and inspect keyed clip receptacles
Hang and latch left/right 1 m side modules
Hang and latch 1 m roof modules from mobile access stands
Fit corner closures, skirts, labels, and earth bonds
Water test, rattle check, snag closeout, and QA release
assembly_plan.release_check: dry interior and signed module map
